  • Constructor Details

    • Replacement

      public Replacement(int startPosition, int endPosition, String text)
      Creates a replacement.
      Parameters:
      startPosition - start source offset, inclusive; must be non-negative
      endPosition - end source offset, exclusive; must be at least startPosition (equal for a pure insertion)
      text - the replacement text (empty to delete)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if startPosition is negative or endPosition is less than startPosition
